maria: Quick check — after last night's outage postmortem a few RWPM tickets still show no clear owners or deadlines: RWPM-8721, RWPM-8722, RWPM-8723. Can owners confirm ownership and timelines?
aj: I'm taking RWPM-8721. Will add acceptance criteria and link the patch. ETA EOD 2026-04-01.
devon: RWPM-8722 looks infra-blocked (capacity planning). I put a note in the ticket. Can we handoff to @lena to drive allocation?
lena: I can take 8722. I'll update the RACI (I'm R) and move A to @sre-manager. Will add runbook steps and a timeline.
sre-manager: Thanks. I'll be the approver. Also flagging RWPM-8723 (cache eviction lag) — that's a recurring pattern (~every 10 days) and should be prioritized.
maria: Proposed schedule: RWPM-8721 (code fix) due 2026-04-01, RWPM-8722 (capacity plan + reservation) due 2026-04-08, RWPM-8723 (cache eviction mitigation) due 2026-03-31. If owners can't meet deadline, escalate to ENG-LEADS after +48h.
aj: :thumbsup: Updating RWPM-8721 now with PR link and acceptance. PR URL: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/RWPM-8721?focusedCommentId=12345
devon: For 8723 I can ship a temporary knob to force eviction frequency (low-risk). Assigning to myself, ETA 2026-03-29.
oncall-bot: Reminder: RWPM-8722 assigned to lena — due 2026-04-08. No status update in 72h will auto-create escalation ticket RWPM-8722-ESC.
lena: Added RACI lines and attached a draft runbook snippet to the ticket:
```
Owners: lena (R) / sre-manager (A) / infra (C) / maria (I)
Steps: 1) validate capacity plan 2) reserve nodes 3) smoke test
```
I'll open a PR for the runbook today.
maria: Summary of action items: - RWPM-8721 @aj due 2026-04-01 - RWPM-8722 @lena due 2026-04-08 - RWPM-8723 @devon due 2026-03-29. I'll confirm closures at the weekly postmortem sync. If anyone needs to hand off, please call it out here.
devon: If I can't merge the 8723 PR by 03-29 I'll hand it to @aj, otherwise I'll close.
aj: Noted — I'll backstop 8723 if needed.
